findings.message: no journal refs in this clone; fetch +refs/redkiln/journal/*:refs/redkiln/journal/* to read them

proves: every journal ref in this clone is a single-parent chain whose file only grew, and every committed journal keeps at head each complete line it held at base
does_not_prove: that this clone fetched the journal refs (data.read.refs), that history before a shallow fetch's boundary was kept, or that the open items are all a branch leaves open
